copy.title: Deepin · Enterprise Investigation & Decision Automation
copy.description: Every decision starts with an Investigation. Deepin investigates business cases across your systems, shows the evidence and waits for a person to approve.
copy.hero_lede: Before a risk, fraud or compliance decision, your people search systems, read documents and compare records. Deepin does that investigation, shows the evidence behind every finding and waits for a person to approve.
copy.sig_text: New signatory registered · Northwind Lojistik A.Ş.
copy.sc_note: Sample case with a fictional company.
copy.dc_p: Deepin never decides silently. It brings the case to the person with the authority to decide, with every reason and every source attached.
copy.ix_p: You buy an Investigation, not a platform. Start with the one your team spends the most time on.
copy.sp_h: Repeated across a domain, an Investigation becomes a Space.
copy.sp_p: A Space is earned through repetition: the same kind of Investigation in one domain, leaving reusable capability behind. Two Spaces, one grammar.
copy.pf_p: Each reference is shown at the maturity it has actually reached.
copy.hx_p: Deepin Harness gives AI roles, capabilities, knowledge, policies and controls, so agents work as part of an enterprise, not as isolated assistants.

phases.h: Before the decision, someone has to investigate.
phases.p: Eight systems, scattered records and hours of searching, reading and comparing. The trail lives in someone's head.
The same systems, read in one place. Every source is checked and kept with the case.
Three of eight sources carry something material. Each piece of evidence stays linked to where it came from.
The reasoning is written out, with the policy it applies. Nothing has been decided.

phases.h: Keep the decision. Lose the investigation work.
phases.p: Deepin stops and hands a person the case: the finding, the evidence and a proposed decision.

evidence: New signatory is a partner in 2 watched companies
scene.finding: Capital reduction and an authority change within 30 days, linked to watched companies. This matches your elevated supplier risk policy.
